name: United Bankers Oyj
summary: Established in 1986 and based in Helsinki, Finland, United Bankers Oyj specializes in offering a comprehensive suite of investment products and financial services. The firm's asset management capabilities cover a diverse range of investment funds, personalized wealth management, and structured investment options, complemented by securities brokerage services. Beyond this, United Bankers Oyj is active in capital markets, providing corporate finance advisory, listing assistance, arranging equity and debt financing, managing initial public offerings (IPOs), and facilitating crowdfunding.
